Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner accepted Britannica’s Quick Facts entry stating “Born: Nizhny Novgorod, Russia, U.S.S.R.” at face value and treated it as Nemtsov’s birthplace, despite other reputable sources (e.g., Wikipedia, RFE/RL) indicating he was born in Sochi. This conflated the city where he was raised (Gorky/Nizhny Novgorod) with his actual birthplace (Sochi), leading toward the wrong conclusion without sufficient cross-verification.
